hypothesis: At the measured best 128-thread CTA/tile setting, each source is staged as a full 28-byte Particle even though force calculation uses only x, y, z, and mass. Staging a 16-byte source record should reduce per-block shared memory from 3,584 to 2,048 bytes and avoid staging unused velocity fields. The CTA mapping, source order, and arithmetic remain fixed; any performance benefit must be established by the official measurements.
notes: The proposal keeps one target per thread and preserves source interaction order and the partial-tile/output bounds. It reduces shared-memory allocation relative to the valid 128-thread parent; correctness and performance remain for the controller to evaluate.
transformations: Keep block and items_per_block at 128, with exactly one target per thread and the existing source-tile iteration and barriers.
Stage only source x, y, z, and mass in a compact four-float record, preserving source interaction order and force arithmetic.
Set dynamic shared-memory allocation to 2,048 bytes for 128 compact source records; retain partial-tile and output-bound handling.
